hardware: same-card production comparisons; appendix includes NVIDIA A6000 forward-level measurements
baselines: GLANCE same head as width-1 chain

settings.name: same-engine head-to-head
settings.description: SGLang 0.5.6, one card, both speculative arms CUDA-graph captured, 32 draft tokens/round; EAGLE3-VL uses 8 sequential draft passes vs GLANCE 1.

settings.name: training
settings.description: 8000 COCO + 8000 TextVQA target-greedy generations, 16K teacher-forced rows, one epoch, target and vision tower frozen.

settings.name: block head
settings.description: 5 layers, 1.05B params, block size 16, fused target layers 1/9/17/25/33.

settings.name: greedy correctness
settings.description: every greedy run gated on reproducing target decoding; fp32 theorem plus bf16 tie-aware production gate.

data.correctness: Greedy mode is lossless under verifier/margin assumptions and audited prompts reproduce target. Sampling preserves target distribution but byte identity is undefined.
data.methodology: Five tasks ordered open-ended→grounded; same-engine/round-budget wall-clock comparison, matched-training drafter comparison, tree-vs-chain ablation, fused-state ablation, entropy fits, target/modality transfer, long-context checks.
data.scope: Claims are batch-one and decode-only. Larger batches are unclaimed; cross-target fits partly use proxy drafters.
